title: New Session
summary: The user and the assistant initially intended to continue working on an English literature project PDF, but the assistant encountered errors reading the file and locating the browser tab. To address the underlying screen-reading issue, the assistant launched OpenCode, switched the model to DeepSeek V4 Flash, and resumed the continuation session as directed by the user. Although a Python library was installed and OpenCode was tasked with troubleshooting the setup, the system confirmed that the core Tesseract OCR binary was still missing. OpenCode provided resolution methods, including running a `winget` installation command or downloading the binary manually from GitHub. Next time, they need to install the Tesseract binary properly so the assistant can regain screen-reading functionality and proceed with the English literature project.
